cause_definitions.gt_convention: the GT follows a project convention the text does not support, such as 09.01 ready-mix or limestone filler -> Limestone/for all usage
cause_definitions.header_context: the answer needs L0/L1 context that was missing or ignored
cause_definitions.lexical_gap: the term is not bridged between line and library (FR acronyms such as GNT, BPE, GB/BBSG, 'tiède')
cause_definitions.llm_failure: timeout, malformed output, missing ID, truncation
cause_definitions.not_in_library: there is no valid row, but the system forced one
cause_definitions.subtype_parse: an attribute was mis-extracted or not extracted (strength, CEM, RAP/AE %, EWC, grade)
cause_definitions.usage_confuser: a known confusable pair (piers/piles, base/binder, pile caps -> footings, segmental rings, ready-mix vs element)

kind_definitions.false_match: matched, labelled line, triple different from the reference
kind_definitions.false_nm: not_a_material on a labelled line or a material without library equivalent (E)
kind_definitions.match_on_blank: matched on a line whose reference is blank (E, S or A)
kind_definitions.missed: needs_review, while the top1 triple equals the reference (a correct proposal)
kind_definitions.wrong_proposal_reviewed: needs_review, the top1 triple differs from the reference or is absent

labelling_rule: exactly one primary cause from the 7 per row, plus an optional cause_2 from the 7
